capturedAtStatement: NULL BY CONSTRUCTION. This is a specification, not a measurement.
claim: Every render-relevant setting the far-tier appearance instrument depends on, enumerated, pinned, and ENFORCED by a harness generated from this same specification.
whyItExists: Three sessions measured the same byte-identical tile and disagreed by up to 6%. The instrument was specified in prose listing seven settings; Blender exposes far more that move a pixel, and the ones nobody listed are the ones that drifted.

maskSemantics.rule: A pixel is covered when its alpha exceeds 0.5.
maskSemantics.union: Union of the SOURCE and BAKED silhouettes, computed per pose within the same session.
maskSemantics.luminance: Rec. 709 on the linear framebuffer: 0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B.
maskSemantics.unPremultiply: Per-channel ratios divide by that subject's own alpha before averaging; the union luminance ratio does not.

poses.cameraDiscipline: One transform per pose, computed from the SOURCE subject's bounds and reused verbatim for every other subject.

sceneHygiene.clearing: Objects deleted and datablocks purged. bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings is NEVER called: it unregisters the BlenderMCP addon.
sceneHygiene.betweenSubjects: Meshes, materials and images purged between subjects, so datablock accumulation cannot bind a subject to a stale material.
sceneHygiene.subjectIsolation: A subject is rendered ALONE. Other subjects are deleted, or their collection is excluded from the view layer. `hide_render` is FORBIDDEN: scene residency moves the reading by 7.0% on the prototype cell at 1,200 m / azimuth 235, and hidden subjects demonstrably cast shadows onto the measured one. ENFORCED by the harness: no mesh in the view layer may carry hide_render, and the caller-supplied renderable-mesh count must match.

enforcedByHarness: camera.* (type, dof, sensor fit, angle, clip, shift)
sun.* (count, energy, angle, rotation, all three colour channels)
world.* (use_nodes, background node presence, strength, all three colour channels)
sceneHygiene.subjectIsolation (no hide_render mesh in the view layer)
proseOnlyUnenforced: recordedEnvironment (GPU backend) — RECORDED, NOT PINNED, because it describes the machine rather than the instrument.
poses.* — supplied by the capture caller, not readable from scene state before capture.
maskSemantics.* — a property of the measurement code, not of Blender.
sceneHygiene.clearing and betweenSubjects — procedural discipline; only their OUTCOME (isolation and mesh count) is enforced.
enforcementCoverage.honesty: Earlier wording claimed every render-relevant setting was enforced. Four groups above are PROSE-ONLY and are labelled as such at every claim site rather than being wished into enforcement.

harness.behaviour: Reads every pinned value back out of Blender immediately before capture and raises on any mismatch. GENERATED from the spec, so spec and harness cannot drift.

negativeControls.method: Each pinned setting perturbed in turn; the harness must refuse and name the right setting.

cases.perturbed: a mesh left with hide_render = True
cases.refusalText: sceneHygiene.subjectIsolation expected no hide_render mesh in the view layer actual [Mesh_0]

negativeControls.positiveControl: The correct renderable count is accepted without raising.
negativeControls.builtInErrorsCaught: The harness refused two of its author errors during construction: a FILTER_1 enum value that does not exist, and a 1e-6 tolerance a degrees/radians round trip cannot survive.

selfReproduction.toleranceStatedInAdvance: |delta ratio| <= 0.001 and |delta hue spread| <= 0.001 at every pose.
selfReproduction.method: Two full capture cycles, each preceded by a complete purge and rebuild, with FIVE named settings deliberately perturbed between them: view_settings.exposure 0.7, eevee.use_raytracing on, eevee.taa_render_samples 8, render.filter_size 3.0, preferences anisotropic FILTER_16.
selfReproduction.methodHonesty: An earlier draft said the ENTIRE instrument was perturbed. Five settings were perturbed, and they are named above.
selfReproduction.verdict: PASS — exact reproduction at all six poses.
selfReproduction.limitation: No true operating-system process restart: restarting Blender drops the MCP channel this session runs over. The test is purge-and-rebuild within one process.

addedInV2: sceneGraph (use_nodes, frame_current, use_compositing, use_sequencer, use_simplify, use_freestyle, use_white_balance, world.use_nodes)
all three channels of sun colour and world background colour
world.use_nodes guard turning a missing Background node into a recorded mismatch
specLineage.howLineageWasDischarged: NOT by assertion. The full six-pose baseline was RE-CAPTURED under spec v2 and reproduces the spec v1 baseline EXACTLY at every pose, ratio and hue spread alike. Every newly pinned setting was therefore already at its pinned value during the v1 capture.
specLineage.whiteBalanceNote: view_settings.use_white_balance is a per-channel scaling control, the exact shape of the open red-deficit hue finding. It was read as FALSE and the re-capture confirms it was off during the baseline. Had it been on, the hue result would have been suspect.

notClaimedHere: Pinning the instrument does not validate any tile.
EEVEE under one sun is not the shipped Cesium renderer.
